headline: Jazz end Lakers' nine-game win streak

top.headline: Jazz end Lakers' nine-game win streak
top.summary: Keyonte George had 30 points and 10 assists as Utah won 109-97 in Los Angeles. The Lakers shot 38.2%, their worst of the season, and played a third straight game without Austin Reaves (heel). It was only the Jazz's third win of the season.

top.headline: Royals trade Maikel Garcia to Mariners in six-player deal
top.summary: Seattle acquired 3B Maikel Garcia and RHPs James McArthur and L.P. Langevin from Kansas City for RHP Bryce Miller, LHP José A. Ferrer and RHP Logan Evans. Garcia, 26, is a 2025 Gold Glove winner and All-Star under contract through 2030. MLB.com called it the biggest blockbuster of the winter so far.

top.headline: Bedard has right shoulder injury; status undetermined
top.summary: Jeff Blashill confirmed Connor Bedard hurt his right shoulder, the same one he injured in December 2025. Blashill said it happened when Nick Paul lifted his stick on a faceoff. ESPN reported Bedard was set for more imaging and a consultation Wednesday, and surgery could be an option now or after the season.

leagues.name: NFL
leagues.summary: Cowboys hand defensive play-calling to Mike Pettine; Lions put Hutchinson on IR

stories.headline: Cowboys give defensive play-calling to Mike Pettine
stories.summary: Senior defensive assistant Mike Pettine will call the Dallas defense for the rest of the season; Christian Parker keeps the coordinator title. The 4-6 Cowboys rank last in yards allowed per game and gave up 584 yards in a 46-40 loss to the 49ers. Brian Schottenheimer said the move gives them the best chance to win.

stories.headline: Lions put Hutchinson on IR, bring back Kerby Joseph
stories.summary: Detroit placed DE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve with a torn ACL. S Kerby Joseph came off the PUP list, and Dan Campbell said the plan is for him to make his 2026 debut this week.

stories.headline: Mayfield sits out Wednesday; Bucs to decide Friday
stories.summary: Baker Mayfield did not practice and is listed with foot and right thumb injuries. Todd Bowles said he's made progress, with a decision on Detroit coming Friday. Rookie Jalon Daniels took the first-team snaps.

stories.headline: Colts rule out five for Thursday night in Houston
stories.summary: Indianapolis ruled out OTs Bernhard Raimann and Jalen Travis, CB Charvarius Ward, DT Jerry Tillery and TE Will Mallory; CB Sauce Gardner is questionable. Houston is without LB Azeez Al-Shaair and RB Woody Marks, while RB David Montgomery is expected back.

stories.headline: Eagles name Joe Milton starter vs. Steelers
stories.summary: Nick Sirianni said Joe Milton will start Sunday against Pittsburgh as the Eagles come off their bye, per ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.summary: Keyonte George had 30 points and 10 assists as Utah won 109-97 in Los Angeles. The Lakers shot 38.2%, their worst of the season, and played a third straight game without Austin Reaves (heel). It was only the Jazz's third win of the season.

stories.headline: Giannis beats Bucks in first meeting; Milwaukee falls to 1-14
stories.summary: Giannis Antetokounmpo had 27 points and 9 assists as Miami won 137-130 for its sixth straight win. The Bucks have lost 11 in a row, and 1-14 is the worst 15-game start in franchise history.

stories.headline: Hawks win at OKC in Dort and Wiggins' return
stories.summary: Onyeka Okongwu scored 28 and Jalen Johnson had a triple-double as Atlanta, a 6.5-point underdog, won 117-112. Oklahoma City (9-6) has lost four of five while missing Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Chet Holmgren.

stories.headline: Kings finish first 0-7 homestand in franchise history
stories.summary: Phoenix won 128-107 in Sacramento behind 29 points each from Dillon Brooks and Devin Booker. The Kings are 0-9 at home. The Suns reached .500 for the first time this season.

stories.headline: Flagg scores 33 as Warriors drop fourth straight
stories.summary: Cooper Flagg had 33 points, 9 assists and 3 steals in Dallas' 116-94 win. Golden State (8-6) has lost four in a row with Stephen Curry out with a torn right oblique.

standouts.name: Keyonte George
standouts.note: Led a 10.5-point underdog past the NBA-leading Lakers.

standouts.note: Added 3 steals in a 22-point rout of Golden State.

standouts.note: Triple-double in Atlanta's win at Oklahoma City.

ESPN reported Bedard was set for more imaging and a consultation Wednesday, and surgery could be an option now or after the season.

stories.headline: Canadiens hand Hellebuyck first loss with Devils
stories.summary: Jake Evans scored 6:17 into the third and Lane Hutson had three assists in Montreal's 3-2 win in New Jersey. Connor Hellebuyck had been 7-0-0 since the Oct. 23 trade from Winnipeg. The Devils had won seven of eight.

stories.headline: Mammoth end six-game skid against Colorado
stories.summary: Utah beat the Avalanche 4-1 behind 30 saves from Sebastian Cossa. Vincent Trocheck had a power-play goal and an assist.

stories.headline: Barkov, Marchand close to returning for Florida
stories.summary: Paul Maurice said Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand are both close to coming back from knee injuries that have cost them more than a month. Barkov missed all of last season with a knee injury. Florida hosts Buffalo on Saturday.

standouts.note: Set up Jake Evans' third-period winner in New Jersey.

standouts.note: Stopped 30 of 31 to end Utah's six-game skid.

standouts.note: Blanked the Devils after the first period.

stories.headline: Royals trade Maikel Garcia to Mariners in six-player deal
stories.summary: Seattle acquired 3B Maikel Garcia and RHPs James McArthur and L.P. Langevin from Kansas City for RHP Bryce Miller, LHP José A. Ferrer and RHP Logan Evans. Garcia, 26, is a 2025 Gold Glove winner and All-Star under contract through 2030. MLB.com called it the biggest blockbuster of the winter so far.

stories.headline: Manfred: owners won't budge on salary cap
stories.summary: Rob Manfred said owners won't compromise on their salary cap demand, and the AP reports the sport is on track for a lockout starting Dec. 2. MLB proposed a $258.2 million cap and a $180.2 million floor for 2028; players have vowed to reject any cap.

stories.headline: Twins bring back Sonny Gray for two years, $55 million
stories.summary: Gray, 37, returns to Minnesota with an opt-out after the first season. He went 18-5 with a 2.72 ERA in 2026.

stories.headline: White Sox sign Dustin May for three years, $52.5 million
stories.summary: Chicago added the 29-year-old right-hander to its rotation. The Sun-Times says it's the third-largest free-agent deal for a pitcher in team history.
